channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Norfolk's pubs, restaurants and hotels to benefit from new £250k campaign
item.description: Pubs, restaurants, hotels and hospitality businesses in Norfolk will be offered training and support through the new £250,000 Hospitality Matters campaign.

item.title: Homeowner watched masked burglary on CCTV from his hospital bed
item.description: Trevor Perkins pleaded guilty to breaking into property yards from A140 after learning the owner had been hospitalised.

item.title: Major progress of A47 works revealed in new drone video
item.description: Shaun Button, known online as Drone Vision Norfolk, has captured what A47 works, completing the dual carriageway between Norwich and Dereham, will look like.

item.title: Security firm acquired and rebranded by ex-NHS doctor turned entrepreneur
item.description: Security Solutions Yes (SSY), based on Sprowston Road in Norwich, Norfolk, has been acquired by Dr Andrew Threadgold and rebranded as Hawthorne.

item.title: New drone photos reveal progress on rebuilding Norfolk college campus
item.description: New drone photos have revealed the progress being made on rebuilding East Coast College's Great Yarmouth campus.

item.title: Why independent shops can’t — and shouldn’t — stock everything
item.description: One of the most persistent myths about independent shops is that we should stock everything.

item.title: How sketching helps a Norfolk soldier during a tough winter training camp
item.description: THEY say the pen is mightier than the sword and for Private Joe Franklin, it's a gateway to calm.

item.title: Young people need a Norfolk they can see a future in
item.description: “The Liberal Democrat Groups have made it clear: with the right choices, we can open up a brighter future for every young person in our county.

item.title: Enough is enough - time to ban narcissistic ‘influencers’ from restaurants
item.description: In the world of restaurants, Jeremy King is regarded as something of a guru.

item.title: Rock ’n’ roll bar to celebrate anniversary with tribute show
item.description: A family-run bar which has helped bring live rock ’n’ roll back to a seaside village is set to celebrate its first anniversary this month.
